findings.description: The deterministic-4xx replay suppression was defeated by any logical call that interleaved with another call's retry backoff window, so a 400/404/422 could be replayed and the logical call could even succeed on the replay.
findings.evidence: Round 1 (task-3 revision 4), check D-concurrent-replay-bypass: budget=8, maxAttempts=2, widened retry policy for 400; call A received 400 (replay scheduled after the ~500 ms backoff), call B started 120 ms later and returned 200; observed fetchCalls=3, physicalResponses statuses [400,200,200], suppressedNonRetryableReplays=0, aOutcome='A_resolved'. Root cause was that prepareRequest cleared a single transport-global poisonedCallId on every logical call.
findings.resolution: Round 2 (task-3 revision 6): the transport now pins retryableStatuses per logical call at createLlmClient and scopes the poison in an AsyncLocalStorage store owned by each logical call (test/s3b-provider-metering.ts:126-152 and 284-311). The exact original reproduction now yields fetchImplInvocations=2, statuses [400,200], suppressedNonRetryableReplays=1, aOutcome='A_rejected:S3B suppressed a Provider request replay after a non-retryable response.'; a deterministic variant, a three-call overlap and a budget=1 bound also pass (RE-F1a..RE-F1d). Two interleaving regression tests were added.

verdictDetail: Final verdict after two rounds. Round 1 (task-3 revision 4) found 2 adversarial failures and 1 red gate; the Lead reopened task-3 and the owner landed both fixes, so round 2 (task-3 revision 6) is fully green: 49 of 49 grouped adversarial checks (83 individual probe cases) pass and 10 of 10 gates exit as expected. The eight P04 protections are implemented and independently reproduced: model-mapping rejection (including the intentional fail-closed slash rule, now documented and pinned), preflight/live-entry consistency with refusal proven before any fetch or child spawn, endpoint legality across 12 URL forms, single-physical-request behaviour for 400/401/403/404/422 under both the pinned and a hostile widened retry policy, request budgeting of failed and blocked attempts, usage-missing unavailability without fabricated numbers, credential redaction across text/snapshots/errors/response model fields, and DELIV-01 attribution correction plus frozen-schema compatibility. F1 (medium) and F2 (low) are resolved and were re-verified with the exact original reproductions; F3 is resolved (check:repo now exits 0 after the Lead's doc fixes); F5 is resolved as a Lead-owned attribution; only F4 remains open and it is informational (a per-run digest recorded as if reproducible). Scope compliance is clean: no packages/** file modified, no task-3 modification of a tracked docs/reference file, no test or security assertion deleted or weakened (the only deleted test line in both rounds is a replaced import; expect() grew 26 -> 168). No external network and no real Provider API call was made.
